messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from the late-night outage postmortem — we agreed to rework how we measure P95 and the burst window. Putting proposed owners + short timeline here.

aj-ops: Thanks. can we avoid another ad-hoc threshold tweak? want a small, testable rollout plan. :eyes:

sam: Proposal: separate short-tail latency SLO (1s p95) for control-plane calls and a separate throughput-aware SLO for inference lanes. keep error budget for control-plane only.

linh: Agree on split. who owns the control-plane SLO config and dashboard changes?

maria: @aj-ops to own control-plane SLO config + alert tuning. @sam to own inference-lane throughput SLO and rollout plan. ryan to update dashboards and create a read-only view for PGs.

aj-ops: Got it — I’ll start with a small config change branch and a canary deployment to staging. ETA: end of week for initial tests.

ryan: I’ll add a dashboard tile that compares old vs new SLO windows and shows error budget burn trend. will also add an annotations layer for incidents.

oncall-bot: Incident #2026-03-22-77 annotated on timeline — root cause: upstream KV-cache thrash at hour 03:12.

sam: For the throughput SLO, suggested math: 
```
window = 1h
target = 99.5% (latency < 300ms) for inference-units under normal burst
fallback target = 99.0% during known maintenance windows
```
This keeps production apps predictable while giving us a measured error budget.

linh: We should also add a recurring job that looks for correlated bursts across regions (same pattern as last three incidents). assign to me to prototype. ETA 10 days.

maria: Action tracker summary: 
- aj-ops: control-plane SLO config + canary (ETA: 3 business days)
- sam: inference throughput SLO spec + rollout plan (ETA: 5 business days)
- ryan: dashboard tiles + annotations (ETA: 2 business days)
- linh: cross-region burst detector prototype (ETA: 10 days)

aj-ops: Will post PR and link it here when ready. planning to include rollout flags and a small percentage canary.

ryan: I’ll create a readme on the dashboard explaining the new metrics and how to interpret error budget slope.

maria: One more ask: add a short test in the postmortem repo that repros a KV-cache thrash at low qps so we can validate the SLOs don't regress. assign to @sam.

sam: Adding to my list. I’ll put a lightweight load test harness in CI and wire it to the dashboard.

oncall-bot: Reminder: next SLO review sync scheduled in 7 days — please update the tracker beforehand.

maria: Thanks all — I’ll update the postmortem with these owners and timelines now. ping here if anything slips. :white_check_mark:
